name: Source photos orbit into a training portrait
looks: A dozen small source photo thumbnails hang in a loose ring around a central portrait card; a thin progress arc sweeps around the portrait's edge as a percentage climbs, and the thumbnails drift slightly inward on their orbit as if feeding the model. A status chip under the portrait reads "training in progress" and ticks up to "ready" when the arc completes.
build: Thumbnails sit at seeded angles around the centre card, each with a slow independent drift/rotation; the progress arc is an SVG stroke animating `strokeDashoffset` tied to the same percentage driving the status chip's counter. On completion, the arc's colour shifts and the status chip cross-fades to its ready state.
sound: A soft granular hum under the orbiting thumbnails, a rising tone under the percentage, a clean chime on completion.
prompt: Show a model or process training on a set of inputs: ring a handful of small source thumbnails loosely around a central subject card, sweep a thin progress arc around its edge as a percentage climbs, and resolve a status chip underneath from in-progress to ready exactly as the arc completes.
